kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتأنجل (form IIq)
# أَتَأَنْجَلُ (ʔataʔangalu) /ʔa.ta.ʔan.ɡa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# أَتَأَنْجَلَ (ʔataʔangala) /ʔa.ta.ʔan.ɡa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# أَتَأَنْجَلْ (ʔataʔangal) /ʔa.ta.ʔan.ɡal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
